messages:
Lars (oncall): Heads-up 

We had a throughput collapse on embeddings.bulk last night around 23:40 UTC when a set of large batched uploads coincided with a model rollout. p95 held but throughput dropped ~40% for ~9 minutes. Opening thread to decide SLO handling and owners. :eyes:

Tess: I see it. The ingress queue filled and backpressure propagated to the GPU pool. Logs show a spike in 10-20MB payloads.

Ravi: Are these mis-sized user uploads or a client-side bug? If client-side we should throttle; otherwise need a routing fallback.

Marta: Quick breakdown from the traffic sampler: ~85% of the heavy batches came from one integration that switched to a batched endpoint without chunking. Not a single key but a vendor rollout.

Lars (oncall): Initial mitigation proposals:
- Short-term: enable per-API-key ingress throttles for bulk endpoints (soft limit)
- Short-term SLO window: mark throughput SLO as "soft" for 24h (exclude from monthly burn)
- Medium-term: add size-based routing (large batches -> dedicated ingest pool)

Tess: I'm +1 for throttles + size-based routing. We should avoid global SLO drift. Propose we relax throughput target for 24h to avoid noisy alerts while we patch.

Ravi: I'll own the ingress throttle rule and add request-size metric. Plan: burst=5, rate=1r/s per key for payloads >2MB. ETA: 4h.

Marta: I'll handle the SLO dashboard note and statuspage blurb. Draft status: "Temporary throughput window for embeddings.bulk for 24h while we mitigate large-batch ingress issues. Dedicated customers may opt-out via support." ETA: 1.5h.

Tess: I'll add a dashboard panel for payload-size distribution and queue depth. ETA: 3h.

Lars (oncall): Ops-Bot 9;please create follow-ups: ingress-throttle (Ravi), SLO-comms (Marta), panels (Tess), routing-design (Tess/Ravi).

Ops-Bot: Created ticket REDW-4001 with subtasks: REDW-4002 (ingress-throttle) -> Ravi, REDW-4003 (SLO update & comms) -> Marta, REDW-4004 (payload panels) -> Tess, REDW-4005 (size-routing RFC) -> Tess. Due dates assigned.

Ravi: Posting the histogram query I'm adding:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_payload_bytes_bucket{endpoint="/embeddings/bulk",env="prod"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Ping me for canary access.

Marta: Agree we should mark the 24h window as an "operational override" and exclude it from the monthly error-budget calc; will record justification in the postmortem and ticket.

Tess: Doing a quick canary of the throttle rule now. If stable, will roll to prod in 2h.

Lars (oncall): Schedule a 24h check-in: 1800167999. Ops-Bot set reminder. We'll decide to close or extend after reviewing REDW-4001 metrics.

Ravi: Throttle rule applied to canary; initial metrics show queue length back to baseline.

Tess: Panels live in the ops dashboard. Payload 95p = 3.6MB during spike.

Marta: Posted status page: https://status.redwood.dev/incidents/REDW-4001 and added SLO annotation in the dashboard.

Lars (oncall): Thanks team. Attaching this thread to the incident postmortem and marking owners in the action tracker. Closing thread for async follow-up. :thumbsup:

Ops-Bot: Reminder scheduled: 1800167999 - "24h SLO/throughput review for embeddings.bulk incident"
